selection_process: Typist: A 15-minute typewriting skill test out of 100 marks

with a minimum of 50 marks required to qualify. Shortlisted candidates (1:5 ratio based on merit) are then called for an interview. Typist-Copyist: Same as above - a 15-minute typewriting skill test out of 100 marks (50 marks minimum to qualify)

followed by an interview for candidates in a 1:5 ratio. Process Server: Merit list based on SSLC percentage. Candidates are called for interview in a 1:25 ratio based on marks. The interview (10 marks) assesses proficiency in reading/writing Kannada and general knowledge. Peon/Servant: Merit list based on SSLC percentage. Candidates are called for interview in a 1:10 ratio based on marks. The interview (10 marks) assesses proficiency in reading/writing Kannada and general knowledge.
Selected candidates will undergo a probation period of 2 years as per the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules
during which they must qualify prescribed departmental examinations and a Kannada language test.
how_to_apply: Visit the official Ramanagara District Court recruitment website: https://ramanagara.dcourts.gov.in/online-recruitment/
Register using a valid mobile number and email ID (all future communication will be sent to these).
Fill in the online application form carefully with accurate details.
Upload photograph and signature as per the specified size and format.
Pay the applicable application fee online (not required for exempted categories).
Submit the application and download/print a copy for future reference.
Applications can be submitted online from 30.07.2026 to 31.08.2026 (till 11:59 PM), and fee payment must be completed by 01.09.2026 (till 11:59 PM).
important_instructions: Incomplete applications or applications lacking correct information will be rejected. The court is not responsible if SMS/email notifications are not received due to incorrect contact details submitted by the candidate. Applications found to contain false information, fake certificates, forged documents, or concealment of facts will be rejected; if detected after appointment, the candidature/appointment will be cancelled without notice, apart from criminal and departmental action. The skill test for eligible candidates will be conducted on computers at the district court premises, and the Kannada typing test will use the Kannada keyboard layout notified on the website. No changes to submitted applications are permitted after the online submission window closes.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should complete both the online application and the fee payment before the respective deadlines, as late submissions will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Minimum age required is 18 years. Age is reckoned as on the last date for submission of applications. *An additional 5-year relaxation is applicable to all categories as per Government Order No. SIRISU 262 SENANI 2025, dated 24.02.2026. rows.qualification_required: Pass in 2nd PUC or equivalent, along with a pass in Kannada and English typewriting (lower/senior grade) conducted by the Karnataka Department of Public Instruction or Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board. Computer knowledge is not mandatory. Alternatively, a Certificate/Diploma in Secretarial Practice from the Karnataka Technical Examination Board with Kannada and English typewriting as optional subjects at senior grade level is also accepted.
Pass in 2nd PUC or equivalent, along with a pass in Kannada and English typewriting (junior grade) conducted by the same boards, or a Secretarial Practice Diploma at junior grade level.
Pass in SSLC conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Board. Candidates should be able to read and write Kannada. Preference is given to candidates holding a valid driving licence.
Pass in SSLC. Candidates should be able to read and write Kannada.

faq.question: Q1. What is Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Principal District and Sessions Court, Bengaluru Rural District, Ramanagara, to fill 55 vacant posts of Typist, Typist-Copyist, Process Server, and Peon/Servant.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 55 vacancies in total: 10 Typist, 1 Typist-Copyist, 10 Process Server, and 34 Peon/Servant (30 fresh plus 4 backlog) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 31.08.2026 (till 11:59 PM), and the fee payment deadline is 01.09.2026 (till 11:59 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post - 2nd PUC with typewriting qualifications for Typist and Typist-Copyist, and SSLC for Process Server and Peon/Servant. See the Educational Qualification table above for full details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age ranges from 35 to 40 years depending on category, plus a 5-year relaxation applicable to all categories as per the applicable government order.
